messages:
ashley: quick preflight before tomorrow's staging promote — adding here so async is easy. planning to apply two terraform overlay changes + a small k8s manifest tweak for the service account binding. can ppl take a quick look?

mira: ack, paste diffs when ready. any secrets path renames?

ashley: yes — secret path moving from /staging/app/old -> /staging/app/config. also adding kms key reference for db creds. terraform plan looked clean locally.

jon: ping @mira @infra-oncall, i'll review the k8s PR. this is overlay-only (base->staging) via kustomize?

mira: correct. terraform overlay files: staging/overlays/app/secret_paths.tf and staging/overlays/app/kms.tf. k8s patch at staging/kustomize/patch-sa.yaml to add role annotation.

ashley: key bits:
```hcl
# staging/overlays/app/secret_paths.tf
resource "aws_secretsmanager_secret" "app_config" {
  name = "/staging/app/config"
}
# old secret retained until promote completes
```

```hcl
# staging/overlays/app/kms.tf
resource "aws_kms_key" "staging_db" {
  description = "staging DB creds" 
}
```

```yaml
# staging/kustomize/patch-sa.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: app-runner
  annotations:
    eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/staging-app-role
```

jon: small nit — gate the TF apply so infra-oncall role doesn't have secretsmanager:Delete during the runway. accidental deletes are bad.

infra-oncall: i can add a preflight in the release job to assert IAM policy has no destructive actions. +1 on keeping the old secret until traffic verified.

mira: terraform plan summary i saw:
```
+ aws_secretsmanager_secret.app_config
~ aws_iam_role_policy.staging_app_policy (adds kms:Decrypt)
```
no deletes were shown.

ashley: rollout gating proposed:
- terraform plan approved by infra eng
- k8s manifest review done
- release preflight asserts iam/policy non-destructive
- canary to 2 pods, smoke tests pass
- wait 24h then delete old secret

jon: add gating checklist to the PR description so approvals are visible.

ashley: done — PR#4826 https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pull/4826 added checklist and linked terraform plan. @mira @jon please add approvals when ready.

deploy-bot: canary deployment created for staging/app v2026-03-17-ashley. pods: app-runner-5f7d8 (2 replicas). smoke tests queued.

mira: smoke passed, logs look clean. slight metric blip but within SLO. approving TF plan now.

jon: k8s manifest LGTM, leaving final approve on PR.
